name: Haus der Geschichte Österreich
notes: Weekly-paginated JSON endpoint Frontend/load_calendar_events (POST start=YYYY-MM-DD, returns 7 days) drives ~70 recurring tour/kids/event occurrences over the horizon; 4 current exhibitions come from the /category/kalender page's currentProgramElemHolder block, with start/end parsed from teaser+detail text (2 are permanent/open-ended). price_min only set for cat_id 147 (Veranstaltungen, explicitly free) and for exhibitions (general admission price); guided-tour prices are ambiguous (tour fee vs included) so left null.
